assets.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: production UI texture atlas for the approved Legend of the Five Rings Emperor deck builder.
The input image is a STYLE REFERENCE, especially its Save draft, Collection/Setup pills, and Dynasty/Fate tabs. Generate the actual blank button MATERIALS, not another screenshot. Match the reference's restrained Japanese navy lacquer, finely worn gilding, amber rim light, very subtle etched cloth and warm ivory highlights. Premium historical card-game craftsmanship; no chunky fantasy ornament, no plastic, no flat gray fills.
Create one atlas with exactly FOUR long horizontal rectangular blank button plates, one above another, same dimensions/alignment, each plate 1200 pixels wide and 160 pixels tall. Image canvas 1536 x 1024. Plate outer bounding rectangles x=168..1368; row1 y=80..240, row2 y=310..470, row3 y=540..700, row4 y=770..930. Leave true transparent background outside each plate, including gaps. Straight-on orthographic UI, no perspective. Each corner barely rounded. Very fine double brass rim and dark engraved channel just inside; use extremely small edge wear. All plates center mostly quiet and dark enough for legible text.
Row1: normal secondary button, almost-black midnight navy lacquer, subdued antique gold hairline rim, gentle shallow bevel.
Row2: selected or hover secondary button, same midnight navy lacquer, brighter warm gold rim and a restrained amber light gathering along the inside bottom edge. Center stays dark.
Row3: primary Save button, softly brushed burnished gold leaf center, honey-gold to bronze gradient, luminous narrow ivory-gold inner rim, shallow inset bevel; exactly like Save draft in the reference. Center suitable for dark text.
Row4: Fate deck tab, same craft and fine brass double rim, deep jade-black lacquer center, quiet emerald glancing light along bottom.
NO WORDS OR NUMBERS OR ICONS OR LABELS. No drop shadows reaching far outside. Plates are nine-slice UI textures, so preserve quiet stretchable middles and a narrow border (about 10px at asset scale). Maximize subtle material richness, minimize ornament. Make the four plates unambiguously separate on actual transparent alpha.
assets.notes: Opaque material atlas. Runtime AtlasTexture regions sample inside plate boundaries; surrounding checkerboard is never rendered.

assets.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Production transparent nine-slice PANEL BORDER asset for the approved L5R Emperor deck builder. Reference image is style guide only. Make a SINGLE full rectangular frame nearly filling a 1536x1024 canvas, 24px external transparent margin. Whole center must be true transparent alpha. Thin hand-worked antique-gold double rules, tiny worn breaks, engraved black/gold channel, small restrained angular Japanese filigree at all four corners (ornament no more than 45x45 pixels at this resolution). This is the delicate border around Collection and the mat in the reference, NOT an ornate picture frame. Keep all four long sides straight, fine, consistent, and stretchable; very thin bright highlights balanced by dark bronze patina. Corners should be crafted, slightly asymmetrical due to wear yet same proportions. No text, icons, figures, cards, interior fill or scene. Orthographic flat UI view. Crisp gilded detailed metal/inlay with no giant glowing halo. Canvas outside AND inside frame transparent.
assets.notes: Transparent frame. Nine-slice corners remain fixed; center is transparent.
